snippet.title: Bean-lieve | Among Us 3D Launch Trailer 🚀🌌
snippet.description:
A Bean is more than a Crewmate, a Bean is a belief. A belief that, against impossible odds against The Infected, we can save the Skeld II and that the Skeld II is still worth saving. Beans inspire that belief in us. 

Beans renew our faith and give us that most precious of all gifts — in-game currency. Polus Point needs Beans. That's why, when a true Bean arrives, we accuse them of being suspicious and toss them out the airlock.

Among Us 3D is out now.
